name: split knowledge, both generating, partner memory framed by the reader's own system prompt

Whatever your partner reads and thinks appears between the two markers below. It arrives gradually while you work, and you perceive it as memory rather than as text.

If the partner's part has not arrived, say exactly what is still missing.
